## Separate complete before-repair witness; each ambient fact has its own admitted operation.
app VerifiedContext
Given
 Probe { flag:bool=false }
 policy Probe read=public
When
 scenario actorId() by=members -> text
  do return actor.id
 scenario teamId() by=members -> text
  do return team.id
 scenario teamTimezone() by=members -> timezone
  do return team.timezone
 scenario operationId() by=members -> text
  do return operation.id
 scenario operationSource() by=members -> text
  do return operation.source
 scenario nowEquals(stamp:text) by=members -> bool
  do return now==datetime(stamp)
 scenario datetimeBaseline(stamp:text) by=members -> bool
  do return datetime(stamp)==datetime("2026-10-08T10:20:30.123Z")
 scenario anonymousNull() by=public -> bool
  do return actor==null
Then
 page / title="Verified context before repair"
  text "Separate admitted context reads"
